description: Decades after the Enterprise-D era, Picard and the surviving command crew reunite around Jack Crusher, Changeling infiltration and a Borg plan aimed directly at Starfleet's next generation.

s08e01.description: Picard receives a warning from Beverly Crusher after decades apart, drawing him and Riker into a mystery involving her hidden son and a stolen weapon.

s08e02.description: Picard learns more about Jack Crusher while the Shrike closes in and Raffi investigates the devastating attack connected to stolen Starfleet technology.

s08e03.description: The Titan is trapped in a deadly nebula as Picard and Beverly confront their past and Raffi joins Worf’s investigation into a larger conspiracy.

s08e04.description: With the Titan sinking toward destruction, the crew makes a desperate escape attempt while Picard finally connects with Jack as his son.

s08e05.description: Ro Laren arrives to investigate the Titan and forces Picard to confront old wounds while Changeling infiltration inside Starfleet becomes undeniable.

s08e06.description: The crew searches Starfleet’s most secret archive for a weapon against the Changelings, reuniting Geordi and Data with their former shipmates.

s08e07.description: Picard’s crew tries to trap Vadic aboard the Titan while Data battles Lore for control of their shared synthetic mind.

s08e08.description: Vadic seizes the Titan and threatens its crew, leaving Seven and the reunited Enterprise officers to reclaim the ship from within.

s08e09.description: Jack’s connection to the Borg is revealed as Frontier Day turns Starfleet’s new interconnected fleet into a weapon against Earth.

s08e10.description: The original Enterprise-D crew reunites on their restored ship for a final attempt to stop the Borg and rescue the assimilated younger officers.
